resend.welcome_ja_definition: その日の welcome email（件名が /download|ダウンロード/i に一致）のうち、件名に日本語文字（/[ぁ-んァ-ヶ一-龠]/）を含み last_event=delivered のもの。★製品軸とは独立: 1通が製品別の集計とここの両方に入る。★shelf() が "other" と判定する件名も含む（問いは「日本語面が使われているか」であって「どの製品か」ではないため）。★検出器は毎回 自己検査する（既知の日本語件名が一致し、ASCII のみの件名が一致しないこと）。★自己検査が失敗した日は★この値が null になり anomalies に1行 出る。∴ ★0 は「使われていない」／★null は「測れていない」。0 が両方を意味することはない。★母集団の非対称は SHELF_DEFINITION と同じ（Resend 側の件名分類なので smoke を除外していない）。

shelf_definition: welcome email を件名で分類。件名が /download|ダウンロード/i に一致し、かつ registry の plugin key (大小無視) を含むものをその製品の棚へ。どちらも満たさなければ "other"。★2026-08-28 以前は /download/i のみだったため、日本語件名の welcome は全て "other" に落ちていた。★母集団の非対称: db_net_new は source=smoke-test の合成行を除外するが、email_delivered / email_bounced は Resend 側の件名分類なので除外していない（同じ行の2数は別母集団）。

muedsp_reachable.definition: MUEDsp segment only; unsubscribed=false; unique. ★North-star denominator (kimny ratified 2026-07-18: 北極星=MUEDsp セグメント10,000人). Single scope → no OR/AND question.

marketing_contacts_reachable.definition: union across all audiences (currently MUEDsp+General); reachable = NOT unsubscribed in ANY audience (AND/conservative, Chief ruling 2026-07-23). Org-wide reach — NOT the north-star. total (marketing_contacts_total) = billing exposure incl. unsubscribed.

portal_registrations.note: forward-only; not backfillable (recording shipped 2026-07-23). Portal arrivals before that date are only observable in GA4, not here. ★Second discontinuity — see dashboard_link_since (#964; UTC, measured from git and the Vercel production deployment after it shipped): the dashboard did not link to the portal at all until then — before that deploy the only in-product door was the welcome/announcement email, so a rise after it is NOT by itself evidence that a mail landed. Column and query unchanged; only the inflow widened. ★Expect a one-time STEP, not a change in rate: the write is an UPDATE over existing entitlement rows WHERE portal_registered_at IS NULL, so what the dashboard link newly reaches is the standing backlog of owners who held an entitlement since July and never arrived — a cohort that drains once. Reading the step as campaign lift is the specific misread this note exists to prevent. ★Third discontinuity — see `denominator`: from 2026-09-05 this counts THREE modules (muedsat+muedlim+muedrive), on insight課's decision (#378). ★Expect a one-time STEP again, and again it is not rate: MUEDrive owners who had already reached the portal were being counted by nothing, and now they are counted. ★The value did not change because behaviour changed — the population did. Diff denominator between two ★SNAPSHOTS (the JSON this collector emits) to find the exact day. ★The snapshot is the durable place to diff: it carries every key this collector emits, whatever the downstream renderer happens to do with them. (When this field shipped, the renderer enumerated keys and so omitted it — insight課 #432 changed it to pass everything through. ★Stated as history on purpose: a claim about the renderer's CURRENT behaviour would go stale here, which is the defect this very note exists to warn about.) ★Unlike the first two discontinuities there is no date constant to trust, because the snapshot states what it counted rather than when it changed.
